courses.title: Reiki Master & Instructor Class - Level 4
courses.description: A weekend that completes the Usui Reiki training with the Master attunement, the master symbols, Antahkarana and the Violet Breath. It also covers how to give attunements and structure Reiki classes, for those who want to teach; attend at the Winnipeg centre or live online.

courses.title: Combined Reiki Levels 1 & 2 Certification Workshop
courses.description: A two-day beginners' certification in Usui Reiki, taking Levels 1 and 2 together: history and principles, attunements, giving Reiki to yourself and others, the three Level 2 symbols and distance Reiki. Teaching mixes talks, guided meditation and hands-on practice.

left_out: Alleviating Anxiety workshop: dated 12 Nov 2026, before 16 Nov, so out on the date rule (it would pass the new health rule).
